title: Why Is Poop Brown? The Digestion Journey!

lines.text: Time for the number one funny mystery every kid wonders about in secret!
lines.caps: Time for the funny *MYSTERY | every kid wonders about in *SECRET!

lines.text: You eat colorful food: red apples, yellow corn, orange carrots, and purple grapes!
lines.caps: You eat *COLORFUL food: | red apples, yellow corn, and purple *GRAPES!

lines.text: So why does your body waste always end up looking brown?
lines.caps: So why does your body *WASTE | always end up looking *BROWN?

lines.text: Your liver produces a special dark green digestive fluid called bile!
lines.caps: Your liver produces a *FLUID | called *BILE to break down *FATS!

lines.text: Meanwhile, your body recycles millions of old red blood cells every single day!
lines.caps: Meanwhile, your body *RECYCLES | millions of old red blood *CELLS!

lines.text: As food journeys through twenty feet of intestines, friendly gut bacteria go to work!
lines.caps: Friendly gut bacteria *GO TO WORK | breaking down the *LEFTOVERS!

lines.text: They break down the bile and blood pigments into a compound called stercobilin!
lines.caps: They transform the pigments into a compound | called *STERCOBILIN!

lines.text: This compound is naturally chocolate-brown—proving your digestive system is working perfectly!
lines.caps: This compound is naturally *BROWN— | proving your digestion is *PERFECT!

lines.text: Laugh and learn body secrets—subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo!
